newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche slips on Moody's downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche slips on Moody's downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Germany's Deutsche Bank AG slipped in the last minutes of post-bourse trade on Monday after Moody's rating agency said it had cut its rating on the bank's long term deposits to AA1 from AAA.
Deutsche shares, which had been marginally weaker than the stable broader market, extended their decline to close the post-bourse session at 70.59 marks, down 56 pfennigs.
Moody's also cut Deutsche's financial strength rating to B+ and the long term rating of its British subsidiary Morgan Grenfell.
The rating agency said the cuts reflected its awareness of increasingly fierce competitive pressures on the German banking industry.
